subject.title: Rancho Santa Margarita City Council, District 2

text: Councilmember, City of Rancho Santa Margarita

Rancho Santa Margarita is an award-winning master planned community where residents enjoy an outstanding quality of life. To ensure RSM remains a great place to live, we need dedicated, proven, experienced leaders on our City Council.
I’m proud to serve as your Mayor Pro Tem and City Councilmember -- and of all we’ve accomplished:
RSM is Safe: Ranked by the FBI as the #1 safest City in Orange County.
RSM is Financially Strong: Our City has a balanced budget and finished last year with $30 million in reserves – enabling us to provide new capital improvement projects without incurring any debt.

RSM is Beautiful: We constructed the beautiful RSM monument sign at the Alicia Gateway into Rancho – and this year the gorgeous RSM monument sign, decorative fencing/median improvements along the Antonio Gateway into Rancho. We’ve also installed enhanced street lighting/median improvements across our City.

RSM Provides a Special Quality of Life: Our City opened a Kid’s Splash Pad in Central Park; synchronized streetlights to reduce traffic; upgraded our City’s animal services contract to join a local “no kill” shelter; sponsored the popular free Summer Concerts at Central Park; and sponsored the annual Rancho Family-Fest community celebration. RSM has the lowest retail vacancy rates in Orange County – and we work to ensure residents have an array of retail/restaurant opportunities.
As your Councilmember, I’ve successfully implemented important initiatives:
Annual Fire Prevention Program to provide residents critical information to protect their families and homes.
New Veteran’s Monument to honor all who’ve served in our nation’s military.
Suicide Prevention Signs on the Santa Margarita Parkway Bridge.
Business Recognition Program to promote local businesses.
College Internship Program to provide students valuable work experiences.
Upon re-election, my primary goals are to maintain our City’s financial security and protect our City’s award-winning master plan.
I’ll ensure you’re always protected by the finest fully funded police and firefighting forces.
I’ll continue to support policies that promote lower taxes, conservative fiscal policies, and safe neighborhoods and parks.

I’m well qualified to serve – having graduated from the USC Marshall School of Business. I’m District Director for our California State Assemblywoman and serve as your representative on the OC Public Library Advisory Board and Alternate Director for the Toll Roads.
My husband and I have lived in Rancho Santa Margarita for over 30 years, and are proud to call Rancho Santa Margarita home.
I respectfully ask for your vote and continued support.
www.AnneforRSM.com

text: Technology Executive
Costs are rising. Insurance, childcare, everything. I am going to do something about it: work to lower what families pay for insurance, and expand affordable after-school care for working parents.

My wife Elizabeth and I are raising five children in Rancho Santa Margarita. I moved here in 2016. Elizabeth grew up here. Our children attend local schools, I have coached my son's team in Santa Margarita Pop Warner for three seasons, and our family attends San Francisco Solano Catholic Church.

I am a technology executive. I serve as Chief Technology Officer of an Orange County law firm, where I lead the firm's technology department and carry responsibility for our budget, our vendor contracts, our infrastructure and our information security. I hold a bachelor's degree in business administration and a master's degree in information technology, both from California State University, Fullerton, and I completed executive education at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.

My work is reading contracts line by line, negotiating with vendors, and asking what we are actually getting for the money. I do it every day, at scale, with real accountability for the result. That is the experience I would bring to the council, along with the working relationships I have built across Orange County.
If elected, I will be fiscally responsible. I will work to keep our budget balanced, our reserves healthy, and our spending explained in language residents can actually follow.
I will fully support the police and fire services that keep this city safe.
I will work alongside the Orange County Fire Authority, SAMLARC, our state partners and insurance carriers to pursue the wildfire-mitigation credits that can lower what our families pay in premiums.
And I will uphold the core values that made my family choose this city and stay.
I would be honored to serve as the first councilmember elected to represent District 2.

text: Businesswoman/Mother/Entrepreneur
Friends & Neighbors,

My husband and I chose Rancho Santa Margarita to raise our family, build our business, and call it home. As a parent with children in our local public schools, I am committed to preserving the safe, family-oriented community that makes Rancho Santa Margarita a special place to live.

I am proud to hold a Doctorate in Business Administration, a Master of Business Administration in Public Management, and a Bachelor’s Degree in Media Economics. In 2008, I landed at LAX with two suitcases, ready to pursue the American Dream.
Throughout my career, I have helped businesses and organizations grow by identifying opportunities, understanding markets, increasing revenue, and developing strategies for success.
I will bring these leadership and business skills to the RSM City Council, combining strategic planning, transparency, accountability, and an understanding of the economic impact of every decision.

One of the highlights of my career was contributing to a project in Stuttgart, a state capital and host city for the 2006 FIFA World Cup, where I helped develop strategies to increase city revenue, strengthen local economy, and maximize the opportunities created by a global event.

As a proud American citizen, I founded multiple successful businesses and today lead business strategy and operations as a Chief Operating Officer while serving as a business and marketing consultant for clients. I also serve as an HOA Board Member, helping preserve our community's safety, beauty, and quality of life.
If elected to the City Council, I am committed to supporting projects with a focus on long-term community benefit and measurable value for every tax dollar invested.

My priorities include preserving public safety by supporting our police and firefighters, improving affordability by bringing affordable after-school programs to RSM and supporting initiatives that strengthen our local economy. I will also work towards implementing term limits, expanding opportunities for residents to place issues on the City Council agenda, and preparing our city for the future.

If elected, I am dedicated to fostering a positive and collaborative community where residents’ ideas and concerns will guide me in shaping Rancho Santa Margarita's future. I will lead with integrity, kindness, and a commitment to investing every tax dollar for the benefit of Rancho Santa Margarita today and tomorrow.
I look forward to serving as your first City Council member for District 2. I respectfully ask for your support and vote.

Dr. Natalie Guse
